name: Assist Store
author: AssistPress

sections.description:
Assist Store is a powerful toolkit for WooCommerce stores, providing 40+ modular features designed to increase conversions, improve user experience, and streamline the shopping process.

Features

Checkout Optimization

  • Buy Now Button – Direct checkout skip cart
  • Checkout Field Customizer – Customize checkout fields
  • Cart Redirect Manager – Smart redirects after add to cart
  • Checkout Auto Formatter – Auto-format address fields

UI & UX Enhancements

  • Quick View Popup – AJAX-powered product preview
  • Sticky Add-to-Cart Bar – Mobile-optimized floating cart
  • Sticky Product Summary – Floating product info
  • Add-to-Cart Toast Notifications – Visual feedback
  • Micro Reward Messages – Motivational messages

Cart Features

  • Mini Cart Drawer – Slide-in cart panel
  • Cart Quantity Buttons – Plus/minus controls
  • Cart Item Undo – Soft remove with undo
  • Clear Cart Button – One-click cart clearing
  • Cart Icon Badge – Floating cart with count
  • Cart Tab Notification – Browser title updates
  • Browser Tab Cart Attention – Animated title alerts

Inventory Management

  • Stock Progress Bar – Visual stock indicator
  • Back in Stock Notifier – Email capture
  • Low Stock Admin Alert – Email notifications
  • Out of Stock Redirect – Smart redirects

Product Display

  • Product Badges Manager – Custom badges
  • Product Tabs Manager – Custom product tabs
  • Dynamic Button Text – Stock-based text
  • Min/Max Quantity Rules – Quantity limits
  • Quantity Preset Buttons – Quick selectors
  • Product One-Line Summary – Concise info

Upsell & Cross-sell

  • Frequently Bought Together – Manual suggestions
  • Bundle Builder – Enhanced bundles
  • Cart Empty State Upsell – Empty cart suggestions
  • Micro Promotion Engine – Buy X Get Y Lite

Shipping & Delivery

  • Free Shipping Progress – Visual progress bar
  • Estimated Delivery Date – Delivery estimates

Navigation & Memory

  • Recently Viewed Products – Track & display
  • Smart Back to Shop – Memory-based navigation
  • Navigation Memory System – Remember pages

Wishlist

  • Save for Later – Lightweight wishlist

International

  • Currency Auto-Switcher – Geo-based display

Marketing

  • Click-to-Copy Coupon – Easy coupon copying

Account

  • Order History Search – Searchable orders

Shortcodes

  • [assist_store_recently_viewed] – Display recently viewed products
  • [assist_store_stock_progress] – Display stock progress bar
  • [assist_store_delivery_date] – Display estimated delivery date
  • [assist_store_save_for_later] – Display saved items

Widgets

  • Assist Store – Recently Viewed – Display recently viewed products in any widget area

Reviews

Write a review for this plugin on WordPress.org!

Support

For support, please visit assistpress.com/support.

Credits

  • Plugin by AssistPress
  • Built with WordPress Coding Standards
  • Compatible with WooCommerce 5.0+

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/assist-store directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘Assist Store’ in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable desired features in the Features tab.
  5. Configure settings in the Settings tab.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, Assist Store is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can I enable all features at once?

While you can enable all features, we recommend only enabling the features you need to maintain optimal site performance.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Features are modular and only load when enabled. The code is optimized for performance.

Is there a premium version?

This is the complete plugin with all 40 features included. No premium upgrade required.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes, all features use CSS classes that can be customized. The plugin is developer-friendly.
